items.author: Olivier Laurent; Jui-Hsuan Wu

items.difficulty_reason: The author simultaneously eliminates two forms of cut while preserving an explicit bound on variable/checkpoint size. The native proof performs nested well-founded induction on checkpoint/variable size, formula size and finite prefix size, with the full commutative/principal variable-unfolding and arrow/intersection cases retained. This non-routine proof-theoretic construction supports H2; no proof-assistant certification is claimed.
